[C#5]

[Verse 1]
[C#5]
I
the Sun ov man
The offspring ov the stellar
race
My halo fallen and
crushed upon the earth
That I may bring ba-
lance this world
I
son ov perdition
From sheer nothingness trans-
gressed
Unto the highest self
to utmost freedom
To explore the star-
ry nature ov my rage

[Verse 2]
[C#5]I
pulse ov existence
The law ov nature
undenied
I hold the torch
ov Heraclites
So I can shake the earth
and move the suns
I
divine Iconoclast
Injecting chaos in
to my veins
With life accepted
With pain resurrected
Is the embrace ov god
in man pro-

[Intro]
[C#5]found

[Bridge]
[C#5]The
joy ov a
dawn The
ecstasy ov dusk
[E5]Nourished have I this
karmic flow Where
[F5]great above meets
[D5]great below
[C#5]
Let it be
written!
Let it be
[E5]done!
Scattered I walk to-
[F5]wards the
[D5]fractured

[C#5]
